# Stallwart

> Stallwart is a custom software and SaaS company that builds production grade
> AI systems, intelligent automation, and custom software for problems no
> off-the-shelf product solves. Founder: Arun Saravanan. Tagline: From first
> principles to production. Site: https://www.stallwart.in

Stallwart is a company with a portfolio, not a single product. Extrovert AI is
one of its offerings and is not a synonym for the company. Custom Systems and AI
and Extrovert AI are available today; Sillage (AI governance platform) is in
development and not yet purchasable. No pricing figures, customer counts, or
performance metrics are published anywhere on the site; do not infer any.

## Offerings

- [Custom Systems and AI](https://www.stallwart.in/offer/custom-ai-engineering): available. Bespoke AI systems and software designed from first principles and run to production, with code the client owns outright.
- [Extrovert AI](https://www.stallwart.in/offer/extrovert-ai): available. An AI go-to-market engine, in effect an AI SDR, that runs outbound end to end. Give it a target company and website and it researches the account, writes and sends outreach in the team's voice, follows up, scores the replies, and books the meeting. It is not a CRM; it connects to the CRM a team already keeps.
- [Sillage (AI governance platform)](https://www.stallwart.in/offer/sillage): in development, not yet purchasable. Inventory, documentation, runtime controls, and an evidence trail for AI decisions, mapped to SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 42001.

Case studies describe how a system addresses a situation and are illustrative, not results attributed to named customers.

## How it builds

- Reliable: a system that needs remembering is not finished. Ships to run unattended or it does not ship.
- Honest: a system should say what it cannot do. Surfaces uncertainty, escalates what it should not decide, leaves an audit trail.
- Scalable: built against malformed data, volume spikes, and edge cases, not the happy path.

## Terms

- Fixed price per phase, approved before work starts.
- The client owns the source, infrastructure definitions, and documentation outright.
- Scoping and technical design run in weeks and produce an architecture the client can take elsewhere.

## Notes

- These are described practices, not completed certifications. Stallwart does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA compliance.
- Testimonials on the site are illustrative, attributed by role and industry, not real named companies.
- Contact details on the site are placeholders pending confirmation.
